g.text: Validation and version-guarded write (inside one transaction)
(tradeId, version, counterPartyId, bookId, maturityDate as raw values)
stored = findById(tradeId) (skipped if tradeId is blank)
: tradeId, counterPartyId, bookId not blank → INVALID_FIELD
: if stored and version valid: version < stored.version → LOWER_VERSION
: if date parses: maturity < today → MATURITY_IN_PAST
Each validator skips checks whose inputs are invalid, so
one bad field never causes a misleading second reason.
Run ALL validators and collect violations (A-15)
append REJECTED outbox event with ALL reasons
INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE WHERE stored.version <= new.version
STALE: a higher version was committed concurrently (US-106)
